memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Count the Merarites by their clans and families. Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the tent of meeting. As part of all their service at the tent, they are to carry the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts and bases, as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, ropes, all their equipment and everything related to their use. Assign to each man the specific things he is to carry. - Num 4:29-32 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The Merarites were given the heaviest, most structural load — the frames, crossbars, posts, bases, pegs, and ropes. Theirs was the hard, physical labour of carrying the framework that held the whole tabernacle together.

Notice the last instruction: "Assign to each man the specific things he is to carry." Every person had his own particular load. No one had to carry everything, but each had to carry his own share. The weight was distributed, person by person, so that together they could bear what none could carry alone.

This is a picture of how God's people are meant to serve. We each have our own load to carry — our own responsibilities, our own calling, our own part of the work. We are not asked to carry it all, but we are asked to carry our own faithfully.

The New Testament gently balances two truths: "carry each other's burdens" (Gal 6:2), and "each one should carry their own load" (Gal 6:5). There are burdens we help others bear, and there is a load that is ours to shoulder. Wisdom is knowing the difference.

Whatever your assigned load is today — your frames, posts, and ropes — take it up faithfully. And when you grow weary, remember that Christ invites the heavy-laden to come to Him for rest (Matt 11:28).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What is the specific "load" God has assigned to you?
- Are you carrying your own share faithfully?
- When weary, do you bring your load to Christ for rest?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me to carry faithfully the load You have assigned to me. And when I am weary, teach me to bring it to You for rest. Amen.
